scope: Browser application, asset integrity, local static build/server and recorded software lifecycle cases

findings.finding: The browser created sessions from a URL without verifying the recorded model digest; sample digests were ignored.
findings.resolution: Build a coherent release manifest; verify sizes and SHA256 of metadata, graph, evaluation and gallery bytes; verify each sample before decoding. Same-host digests detect corruption and mixed releases, not malicious replacement of all files.

findings.finding: Metadata and runtime input/output tensor names, dtype and fixed shapes were insufficiently validated.
findings.resolution: Require the frozen shared image/score contract and validate both session and actual output tensor contracts before recording decisions.

findings.finding: An earlier in-flight result could publish after a newer image was selected.
findings.resolution: Capture source pixels, session and image generation; discard invalidated work before and after inference and dispose every tensor.

findings.finding: Stopping a replay did not invalidate its pending sample fetch/decode.
findings.resolution: Abort pending fetches and invalidate image/replay generations; no late history entry after cancellation.

findings.finding: Stopped playback could reactivate controls and a stale permission rejection could stop a newer stream.
findings.resolution: Check the media generation after every asynchronous operation; stop only the captured stale stream and expose pending-camera cancellation.

findings.finding: Empty streams and ended tracks were accepted or ignored.
findings.resolution: Require live video tracks, stop on disconnect or inference failure, release tracks on stop/hide and keep one inference at a time.

findings.finding: Image dimensions were checked after native decoding could allocate memory.
findings.resolution: Check PNG/JPEG/WebP signatures, bounded container lengths and dimensions before bitmap allocation; reject animated containers, unsupported types and oversized inputs. Native decoding remains required to validate pixel data.

findings.finding: Invalid output shapes or failed attempts could leave an earlier decision visible/downloadable.
findings.resolution: Clear the previous decision, score and downloadable result as soon as reinspection starts; mark cancelled work without recording a new decision. Reject nonfinite, out-of-range, incorrect dtype/shape/length output; retain only completed history records.

findings.finding: Stored records were weakly checked for dates, scores, decisions and filename size.
findings.resolution: Validate deserialized history; render filenames as text and neutralize CSV formulas. A quota failure keeps the current result and export available.

findings.finding: Copying into an existing output left stale files and could leave a partial failed build.
findings.resolution: Validate all frozen artifacts before staging, publish a fresh directory with rollback, clean stale outputs and refuse source-directory replacement or symlinked public inputs.

findings.finding: The browser app lacked a Node-only local serving entry point.
findings.resolution: Add a loopback static server with GET/HEAD, exact MIME types, true404/405 responses, traversal/dotfile/symlink protection and friendly startup errors.

findings.finding: Camera sampling and model-call time could be mistaken for full-frame real-time throughput.
findings.resolution: Expose a serial250/1000/2500ms post-inference delay, source_timestamp, processing_ms and inference_ms; document their boundaries. Physical exposure-to-result throughput remains unmeasured.

findings.finding: The npm runtime package omitted upstream license files.
findings.resolution: Bundle unmodified official ONNX Runtime v1.23.2 LICENSE/ThirdPartyNotices and nobleMIT license with the static release.

browser_observations.environment: Managed Chrome via the supported Sites preview; actual onnxruntime-web WebAssembly; HTTP preview also exercises the bundled SHA fallback
browser_observations.replay: Started, advanced real samples and stopped with controls restored; software generation races independently tested in NodeVM
browser_observations.history_reload: Four completed records retained after reload; automatic normal sample added a fifth completed record
browser_observations.camera_fallback: Camera access unavailable on HTTP preview; displayed upload fallback without accepting a permission prompt
browser_observations.physical_camera: unverified; deterministic streams test software lifecycle only
browser_observations.keyboard_navigation: Home selects Original and End selects Error map; overlay checkbox off renders the residual-only view.
browser_observations.diagnostics: No observed application failure. ONNX Runtime logs a nonfatal unknown-CPU-vendor warning in this cloud environment; unrelated browser-extension metadata errors are present.

coverage_limits: Native operating-system file chooser was not reverified in this browser; actual File objects and the application upload functions are covered in the VM, and browser PNG decoding is exercised by real gallery samples.
Physical camera capture, exposure timestamps, target-line motion and long-duration high-rate operation were not measured.
Browser/device/codec coverage is finite; this audit does not establish absence of unknown bugs.
Software correctness does not change the frozen19.3%defect recall or establish production qualification.
